interface.shortDescription: Local execution, testing and desktop control on heaven
interface.longDescription: Use the user's private Heaven Local Bridge as the default path for computer work on heaven. It supports structured filesystem operations, commands, persistent sessions, code/build/test execution, local agents, screenshots and structured desktop control through the private GitHub relay. Do not use Remote Desktop Commander unless explicitly authorized.
defaultPrompt: Use Heaven Local Bridge to run and test this code on heaven; do not use Remote Desktop Commander.
Use Heaven Local Bridge for this heaven computer task and return authoritative result evidence.
Check Heaven Local Bridge health and run the relevant build/test commands on the heaven worker.

name: heaven-local-bridge
description: Primary local-control and code-execution bridge for the user's heaven worker. Use it instead of Remote Desktop Commander unless explicitly authorized.
